highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.2 improves Ganesh flush and upload failure handling.

bullets.lead: Flush failures propagate through native rendering
bullets.detail: Separates task execution from success and propagates task, flush, and submission failures. Existing C and managed flush operations remain ABI-compatible void calls.

bullets.lead: Failed GPU uploads no longer feed stale draws
bullets.detail: Ganesh checks failed buffer uploads and initialization under memory pressure instead of drawing stale contents. Triangulated paths retain CPU vertex data for a later upload attempt.

Corrects the compiler-warning configuration that caused BinSkim BA2007 failures in applications consuming HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32. Native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected.

harfbuzz_summary: Windows native assets correct the warning suppression that caused BinSkim BA2007 failures. This package revision does not upgrade native HarfBuzz or change its shaping behavior.

v4.152.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.2 improves Ganesh flush and GPU-buffer upload failure handling.
